//: Declaration emit only. Zx is written in plain ES2022 with JSDoc types — there is no
TypeScript in the sources and no TypeScript in the build output. This config exists so that
the public types already written for humans are also handed to editors: `tsc` reads the JSDoc and
`checkJs` is off globally and opted into per file with `// @ts-check`. Every module in
`src/core/` carries it, so the shared kernel is type-checked on every build — the build fails
on any tsc output. The rest of the public tree is not there yet: components and custom
elements still report JSDoc inaccuracies, and
switching them on wholesale would be a large change disguised as a config flag. Add the
pragma to a file once it is clean, and the guard extends with it.
